title: Non-Archimedean Massera-Schaffer-Maligranda-Pecaric-Rajic Inequality
content: Massera and Schaffer [\textit{Ann. Math. (2), 1958}] derived a breakthrough upper bound for the Clarkson angle between two nonzero vectors in a normed linear space, which was later improved by Maligranda [\textit{Am. Math. Mon., 2006}]. Pecaric and Rajic [\textit{Math. Inequal. Appl., 2007}] extended Maligranda's inequality to finitely many nonzero vectors. We derive a non-Archimedean version of Massera-Schaffer-Maligranda-Pecaric-Rajic inequality.
